admitted_region.unit_coordinate_units: dimensionless unit-box coordinate u in [0, 1] (internal x = ln v for log, v for linear)

headline_conditions.admissibility: A13 as corrected by A23 (ROOT_DECISIONS_NGC3198_CONSTRUCTION_2026-10-17_V004_ADDENDUM.md, open, cited by name): Fixing D_DDO154 = 4.04 Mpc is a counted assumption of the headline calibration, forced by the stage bindings (run mode at D ≠ 4.04 is BLOCKED). 4.04 Mpc is the registered route-B/catalogue distance; the region distance_summary central value is 4.0365 Mpc, with conditional 68% interval [3.981, 4.111] Mpc. For exact admitted sets, the D = 4.04 slice lies inside the projection of the 4-D admitted region. Every freeze member is an admitted point, and forward_ngc never receives the DDO154 distance. Every computed slice band therefore lies inside the exact projection envelope, and a member within error on the slice is a member within error of the projection. Nothing stronger is claimed. The frozen headline (min/median/max of the per-member counts plus the reference-member count) is not monotone under restriction, so the test is not claimed to be stricter. The computed INNER_SAMPLE estimates of two different runs are not ordered. A miss on NGC3198 is read as conditional on D_DDO154 = 4.04 Mpc and i_DDO154 = 66° until the D Jacobian column bounds that effect.

ngc3198_slot_sensitivity.ruling: Summary of root ruling A16.1 (V004 addendum; V004 is open, so it is cited by name and not pinned). The headline uses the registered geometry: 13.8 Mpc, physical inclination 72 deg, released-mean 73 deg. The forward route cannot evaluate D != 13.8 or i != 72: inclination is not exposed (PC-5), and the stage bindings fix the geometry. The declared boxes are kept as the declared range of a sensitivity labelled NOT_EVALUATED_BEFORE_FREEZE. The headline bands do not include them; as in A13, this can only narrow the bands, so the test becomes stricter. If the freeze module requires an evaluated box-limited band, root changes the declaration before ROOT_CALL_ORDER step 5 and never fills the band with guessed values.

The module has no NOT_EVALUATED path for these slots: evaluate_sensitivity plans and calls forward_ngc at both box ends of both slots, counts a refused call as evaluated, and keeps status COMPLETE.

A18-ROOT-V004.text_verbatim:
## A18: C̄ in-plane anisotropy is systematic and kernel-dependent (Claude3 FROM_CLAUDE3/0037; 2026-10-17 ~22:10Z)

Result: `claude_artifacts/cbar_anisotropy_c3/RESULT_CBAR_ANISOTROPY_C3V001.md` (b29d77c3). The decision rule was registered before the computation was run.

**Systematic (TESTED).** The lattice-symmetric null is rejected:
- chain level, p 7.5e-5; run level, p 0.0048;
- the excess is C_yy > C_xx along lattice y.

**Kernel-dependent, so not a kernel-independent property (TESTED).** The asymmetry q varies about 30× across sampler kernels at the same state point:

| Kernel | q |
|---|---|
| V004 | 0.37–0.45 |
| Admission/cycle (A2's chains) | 0.03–0.055 |
| Worm, birthk, current-graph (incl. the 8192-sample long run) | ≤ 0.016, no y preference |

At least part of A2's anisotropy (q = 0.039) is therefore sampler-induced. Whether any part is an equilibrium property of the born graph is UNTESTED.

**Consequences:**
- **No coefficient-grid change now.** A switch would invalidate the sealed convergence test and every DDO run, and the BirthK evaluation's "keep A2 provisional" stands.
- **A2's in-plane anisotropy is a counted coefficient-estimation limitation.** It enters the freeze manifest notes next to SA-REACH-01. Route B's m=0 projection averages it to first order.
- **The deciding tests go to the sampler lineage (P-96 groundwork, Claude4 R-D):**
  1. a static x↔y invariance check of the born graph, initial configuration and move set;
  2. one chain started rotated 90° about z.

  A coefficient grid from the better-mixed kernels (worm/birthk) is the candidate sensitivity grid for the NGC outer rows. It is never a silent replacement.

SA-BH-01.pre_declared_reading_verbatim: Every 120/43 miss is therefore read two ways: as a model failure, or as the missing history/species dependence. A miss is never reported as a failure of UNT in general.
SA-BH-01.text_verbatim: Every baryonic source (stars at M/L 0.5, HI ×1.36, H2) enters only as −mc² in the lapse channel, through one static kernel. The weight per unit mass is the same for every source. There is no dependence on Bind history, record age or species.

SA-REACH-01.text_verbatim: lapse response at L=4 has finite negative T(0) and sign change k*; no 1/r tail
